consumer: mission::is_complete for the MGOAL_FIND_ITEM/deliver goal, asking 'does the player hold the required count of the package item so the turn-in is eligible?'
scope: items within crafting_inventory() reach: the character's own carried items PLUS items reachable nearby (adjacent tiles/containers/vehicle cargo), not on-person only
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — computes a yes/no by testing u.crafting_inventory().has_amount/has_charges(type->item_id, item_count); the engine EVALUATES turn-in eligibility from this
divergence: the package sits in an adjacent vehicle cargo trunk (within crafting_inventory reach) but not on the player's person: a carried-items-only proxy (write_carried_items / set_has_items, on-person only) answers 'cannot turn in' while mission::is_complete answers 'can', exposing the wrong-reach answer
